758:t_1:317.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm so sorry I'm late! $$ノノ$$... has just arrived!」

758:t_1:318.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're late! The meeting time passed ages ago!」

758:t_1:319.en:
$$チコ$$
「For starters, do you even realize that this delegation was sent because of what you said, that you wanted to go to $$シリウス$$?」

758:t_1:320.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Of course I do! Because it might fundamentally change the way the universe works!」

758:t_1:323.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That back when $$シリウス$$ and Earth had exchanges, there was an attempt to communicate with the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

758:t_1:325.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Why did you keep quiet about something that important!?」

758:t_1:326.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I-I'm sorry, Big Sis! $$ノノ$$ only just remembered it recently, too!」

758:t_1:327.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That there are also $$宇宙怪獣$$ that evolved in a completely different direction from that $$変動重力源$$.」

758:t_1:328.en:
$$チコ$$
「The $$バアル$$ created by the force that seeks to vanish... the $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

758:t_1:329.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If they have intelligence and we can communicate with them...」

758:t_1:330.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The clash between the force that seeks to exist and the force that seeks to vanish... In other words, the system of the universe's collapse changes too.」

758:t_1:331.en:
$$ノノ$$
「See, Big Sis? Just like $$ノノ$$ said, right?」

758:t_1:332.en:
$$ラルク$$
「And you're only remembering something that important now...!」

758:t_1:333.en:
$$チコ$$
「Now, now... It sounds like that was a very long time ago, so who knows how things are now...」

758:t_1:334.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Then the only way is to go to $$シリウス$$ and find out.」

758:t_1:335.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...Let's go, $$ノノ$$. Everyone is waiting for us.」

758:t_1:337.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Even with the legacy of the old civilization in hand, Earth's warp technology is still immature. It'll be a very long trip to $$シリウス$$.」

758:t_1:338.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll be fine. As long as you're with me, Big Sis.」

758:t_1:341.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I promised, didn't I, $$ノノ$$? We'll always be together, from here on too.」

758:t_1:342.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Big Sis! Forever, wherever we go!」

758:t_1:343.en:
$$ノノ$$
(And someday... we'll get to meet all of you, too, right...)

758:t_1:348.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Looks like you finally woke up, Brat $$シンジ$$.」

758:t_1:350.en:
$$カヲル$$
「As you can see, it's our world.」

758:t_1:351.en:
$$マリ$$
「With that $$超時空修復$$, the world went back to how it was, and we got sent back too, nya~.」

758:t_1:352.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「Along with the EVAs.」

758:t_1:354.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Well then... now that Brat $$シンジ$$ is awake, Four-Eyes and I are leaving.」

758:t_1:356.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Isn't it obvious? We're rejoining $$ヴィレ$$.」

758:t_1:357.en:
$$マリ$$
「Exactly. The game of playing friends is over, as of now.」

758:t_1:359.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I thought you'd changed at least a little after saving the universe, but you're as mopey as ever...」

758:t_1:361.en:
$$アスカ$$
「What are you planning to do from here on?」

758:t_1:362.en:
$$マリ$$
「Want to come to $$ヴィレ$$? By rights, that's how it was supposed to go in the first place.」

758:t_1:364.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Make up your mind! What do you want to do!?」

758:t_1:366.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Because I don't know, I want to think.」

758:t_1:368.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... in that case, you probably don't want to go to $$ヴィレ$$, where you'd be held in custody.」

758:t_1:370.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I get what you're thinking. ...Then we're leaving.」

758:t_1:372.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't talk to me so casually. From here on, we're enemies again.」

758:t_1:374.en:
$$マリ$$
「Bye-bye~. Though I'd rather not run into you on the battlefield.」

758:t_1:377.en:
$$カヲル$$
「They'll go their own way... Let's go too.」

758:t_1:379.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「That is for you to decide.」

758:t_1:381.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't know what's waiting ahead... But I can't just do nothing, either...)

758:t_1:382.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I'll move forward... Even if it's one step at a time, by my own will...)

758:t_1:386.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Clear skies over $$パラダイムシティ$$ again today. Hard to believe every day used to be overcast.」

758:t_1:387.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「Indeed, sir. I shall leave today's morning paper here.」

758:t_1:388.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If that thug $$ベック$$ is causing another commotion, it'll ruin this perfectly good mood...」

758:t_1:389.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「$$ロジャー$$... Your client has arrived.」

758:t_1:390.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「It's been a while, $$ロジャー$$.」

758:t_1:391.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never expected my client to be you...」

758:t_1:393.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「No... A visit from a beautiful woman is always welcome.」

758:t_1:394.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「Thank you. Hearing you say that makes it easier to talk.」

758:t_1:395.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Looks like I'm about to be handed a rather difficult problem...」

758:t_1:396.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「Then will you turn it down?」

758:t_1:397.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「$$ロジャー$$ wouldn't do that. He always sees a job through.」

758:t_1:398.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thank you, Dorothy. I'll do everything I can to live up to your expectations.」

758:t_1:399.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(My name is $$ロジャー・スミス$$... I'm this city's Negotiator...)

758:t_1:400.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(This is $$パラダイムシティ$$... I have neither memories nor a past, but a bright future should await both this city and me...)

758:t_1:401.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(A tomorrow as clear as today's weather... I'd like those who will surely come visit someday to see this clear sky too.)

758:t_1:405.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「...$$セツコ$$. Is the data for submission finished?」

758:t_1:401: 彼等 (Roger's thought) rendered 'those who will surely come visit someday' - referent (the Z team?) not settled in-scene, kept ambiguous.
758:t_1:380: 僕が… rendered 'Me...' (fragment, kept as is).
758:t_1:355: 行くって… rendered 'Leaving...' (subject not stated in source; Shinji echoing Asuka).
758:t_1:327: continues Nono's 思い出した from 326; written as a fragment 'That there are also ...' as in Japanese.
uncertain: シリウス (the star system) uses the pilot token $$シリウス$$ (Sirius de Alisia's token); no star-system entry in the sheet, English is the same 'Sirius'.
$$宇宙怪獣$$ ('Space Monsters', keyword token) used for plural general reference in 323/327/328; 329 'they' refers to them.
758:t_1:349 reused Tengoku 'Where...' for ここは…; 'Where am I...' would read more naturally.
758:t_1:343 and 401: reference of 皆さん / 彼等 (assumed the Z-team heroes) not verified.
758:t_1:368 拘束される rendered 'held in custody' (WILLE would detain him).
